versions.changelog:
rednote-viral-writer v1.0.0

- Initial release with an end-to-end guide for writing viral Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) notes.
- Provides a five-part template based on >9000-like posts for high engagement.
- Includes example structures, cross-topic adaptation formulas, and title-writing formulas.
- Offers detailed writing checklists for each paragraph and sample posts.
- Recommends effective hashtag strategies and a streamlined 5–10 minute workflow.
